interpretation.auc_delta: v3 is 1.2pp worse than v2 on AUC — within tolerance, calibration is similar

interpretation.fee_sensitivity_persists: Even with cleaner LOO encoding, the sensitivity test shows flat curve (0pp span). The model honestly reproduces the data: within normal fee range firm/market fit dominates, only Q4 extremes hurt.
